ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota's Somali Community
ideas.description: This story would investigate allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Somali community, and explore the role of outside funding in local communities.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud?
What role does outside funding play in local communities?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud and abuse of power. By following the money and exploring the role of outside funding, we may be able to shed light on a complex issue and hold those responsible accountable.

ideas.title: The 'No Kings' Protests: A Growing Movement Against the Trump Administration
ideas.description: This story would explore the 'No Kings' protests and the growing movement against the Trump administration.
questions: What are the goals of the 'No Kings' movement?
How is the movement being received by the public and the media?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to provide insight into a growing social justice movement. By exploring the goals and reception of the 'No Kings' movement, we may be able to better understand the complexities of the issue and the perspectives of those involved.
